issues.where: Lesson 5 (the 'What learners learned' passage against the 'How it explains the phenomenon' passage)
issues.problem: Lesson 5 contradicts itself on when moments add and when they subtract. The 'learned' text says opposite-sense moments are subtracted in the jembe problem, where the 20 N friction acts on the other side of the pivot, and that the oxen on opposite sides add. The 'explains' text says moments add when forces are on opposite sides of the pivot and subtract when both forces are on the same side (the door). Under that rule the jembe, with forces on opposite sides, would add, not subtract. The rule should depend on whether the forces turn the object in the same sense or in opposite senses, not on which side of the pivot they act. Part 3 of the Final Explanation follows the 'learned' version, so no Final Explanation can agree with both passages.
